script_text: Aquarius, this week snaps your ruler Uranus into the room, and your air-sign mind has to choose between comfort and truth. Monday through Wednesday, Venus in Gemini trines Uranus in your 1st House, making flirtation, texting, and bold self-expression magnetic, while Mars in Taurus squares Pluto in your 10th House, so Tuesday is tense for bosses, budgets, and ego battles. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters Cancer and your 6th House, turning attraction into practical care, shared routines, and a money-saving habit. The mid-week turning point is the Venus trine Uranus: someone reveals what they really want. Thursday through Sunday, the Sun in Gemini sextiles Saturn in your 2nd House, making Friday best for contracts, rates, and a serious money conversation. Saturday’s Moon in Libra harmonizes with Jupiter, so romance feels generous, but Sunday asks you to protect your energy. Best day: Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 6th House and trines your ruler Uranus. Worst day: Tuesday is hardest because Mars squares Pluto in your 10th House. Weekly advice: send the contract, not the emotional essay. Follow for daily updates.
